ticket.summary: Gas water heater pilot won't stay lit (drops after ~10 min) since tonight, no hot water in home with 4-month-old infant; likely thermocouple, unit installed by us 2025-06-14 and within 2yr labor warranty.
mitigation_advice: Leave the pilot off overnight instead of repeatedly relighting; no leak or gas odor present so no shutoff needed
If a gas/rotten-egg smell ever appears: evacuate everyone, do not touch switches, phones or appliances, and call the gas utility emergency line or 911 from outside [PB-06]

quote_lines.description: Water heater pilot/thermocouple service (review for 2yr labor warranty coverage - Rheem 40gal gas installed 2025-06-14 by us)

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Sam. Nothing you need to do tonight - leave the pilot off rather than relighting it over and over, and the tech will diagnose it in the morning. If you ever smell gas or rotten eggs, get everyone outside immediately, don't touch switches or appliances, and call the gas utility's emergency line or 911 from outside [PB-06].
